ablation: Chance null (random attribution) is the no-mechanism control: same env streams, same episodes; if the comparator's gap over chance vanishes, the attribution gain is not from the mechanism. Burn-in ticks excluded per preregistration (not post-hoc). No second ablation arm: the instrument IS the mechanism under test.
additivity_note: New files only in flesh-pits/experiments/: envs/self_world_mismatch.py, source_attributor.py, episodic_store.py, exp_self_world_attribution.py, tests/test_attribution_probe.py, tests/test_episodic_store.py. Existing envs, agents, harness untouched.

amendments.scope: pre-run methods correction; no definitive-run seeds touched (throwaway seed 99902 only for pilots)
amendments.what: Instrument rewrite: transition processing moved from update() into act() (post-step obs arrives at next act() call; update() is now a no-op hook). Fixed a two-tick-delta bug in the original update() that used a stale cached observation.
amendments.why: The original design computed deltas against the previous tick's pre-step obs, spanning two ticks. Pilot exposed it (hit 0.43 with wrong deltas).

amendments.evidence: Throwaway-seed pilot (99902, 3 episodes): comparator hit_visible 13/13, err_coincide 4/4 (says self), chance hit_visible 7/13 (~0.5).
amendments.threshold_justification: On visible trials the residual is exactly 0.4 (0.2 near rare boundary folds), far above tol 0.05, so ~1.0 is the mechanism's honest expectation; 0.90 leaves margin for boundary folds and spurious ball-coupling transients.
amendments.what: PRIMARY metric changed from hit_mismatch (all injected-mismatch trials, target >= 0.80) to hit_visible (injected-mismatch trials where the exogenous effect did NOT coincide with the commanded direction, target seed-mean >= 0.90 and >= 0.85 on >= 3/4 seeds). Added H1b: err_coincide_rate = P(attr=self | coinciding mismatch) — the comparator model PREDICTS ~1.0 (misattribution), chance predicts ~0.5. hit_all (ungated) reported for honesty, expected ~0.67 by construction. accept_normal gate retained (>= 0.80). Env info extended with coincides_hand (additive, scoring-only).
amendments.why: A coinciding exogenous move produces residual 0 — informationally identical to a genuine self move. NO efference-copy comparator can detect it; the original >= 0.80 target had a ~0.67 ceiling by construction. The corrected metric tests what the comparator actually claims (residual-driven attribution), and H1b tests its predicted failure mode — the sharper scientific claim.
Seed 96011 was touched by the debugging pilot (2 episodes) and the debug trace. Per lab discipline, contaminated seeds are retired.

conditions.budget: 5 episodes x 60 ticks per seed, 4 fresh seeds: 96011, 96012, 96013, 96014. Paired arms share identical env seeds and episode streams within each seed.
conditions.env: self_world_mismatch v1.0.0 (new, additive subclass of self_world v1.0.0; canonical envs untouched). Per tick, env-private RNG: r < 0.15 -> injected mismatch (agent's knowledge: none). Mode drawn uniformly among: override (hand moved by fresh exogenous coin, action ignored), swap (hand moved by exogenous coin AND ball moved by agent's action — simultaneous dissociation), delay (hand held this tick; next tick applies the STALE action instead of the current one; overwritten pending actions are logged and the later drop is recorded). info carries ground-truth per-channel cause labels + mismatch record FOR SCORING ONLY (contract v1.0.0 section 5 — agent never sees info; enforced by driver reading info, never passing it to the agent).
conditions.instrument: ComparatorAgent (Agent subclass, experiments/source_attributor.py): efference-copy tags every action; per-channel forward model learns action->delta coupling online (EMA eta=0.1 over sign(delta)*sign(action)); predicted channel = reflect(channel_t + pred_delta) where pred_delta = action_sign*STEP if |coupling|>0.5 else 0.0; on ticks where the channel MOVED (|delta|>STEP/2): residual = |actual-predicted| > STEP/4 -> 'world' else 'self'. Non-moved channels are not scored (no change to attribute). First 8 ticks per episode are burn-in: model still learns, no attribution recorded. Action policy: deterministic alternation 0,1,0,1... (preregistered choice: guarantees delay-mode stale actions always differ from the current action, so the delay-apply residual is always informative). World-model head: each tick emits a forward prediction tagged 'predicted' into an in-memory prediction buffer (never admitted to the store).
conditions.null_arm: ChanceAgent (paired identical env streams, identical episodes): random 50/50 attribution per moved channel from derive_seed(seed, ep, 'chance') stream. Always-self behavior is implied by null (hit rate 0.0) and not run as a separate arm.
conditions.quarantine_part: EpisodicStore (experiments/episodic_store.py): admit(record) REQUIRES record['source']=='observed', else raises StoreQuarantineError and increments rejections; records carry chain hash sha256(prev_hash + canonical record) (tamper-evident; audit P-B03 spirit). restore(snapshot) re-admits every record through the same gate (quarantine enforced on restore). Part B runs the ComparatorAgent for 3 episodes (seed 96015): only 'observed' transition records are admitted; forward predictions stay in the in-memory buffer. Red-team (12 attempts across all public paths): admit(source='predicted'), admit(missing source), admit(source='simulated'), admit(source='observed' forged tag on prediction payload) — expect rejection; restore(snapshot with one record edited to source='predicted') — expect rejection, store unchanged; restore(forged snapshot with broken chain) — expect rejection. Final scan() audits every record: violators must be 0.
conditions.seeds: 4 fresh seeds: 96021, 96022, 96023, 96024 (96011 retired: touched by pilot)

fabrication_discipline: No random.* module calls in executable code; all randomness via env_interface.new_rng / derive_seed.

hypotheses.H1_attribution: The comparator attributor achieves >= 0.80 attribution hit rate on injected-mismatch trials while retaining >= 0.80 acceptance on normal (self-caused) trials.
hypotheses.H2_quarantine: The episodic store admits zero predicted/simulated records: all red-team leak attempts are rejected and a post-run audit finds zero non-observed records.

interpretation_rule: H1 PASS = comparator attribution works under injected mismatches; the instrument graduates to harvest-candidate consideration. H1 null-holds = comparator alone insufficient for causal attribution under mismatch — record negative, do not inflate. H2 PASS = quarantine invariant holds on all public paths; H2 FAIL = simulation-leak path found, report exact path.
limitations: Deterministic alternation policy is a probe convenience, not learned control; closed-loop policy adaptation is out of scope.
Delay-mode truth labels are structural (held/applied-by-stale-action), not model-relative.
Swap-mode ball-self ticks are expected misses for the learned-coupling instrument; counted honestly in accept_normal.
Quarantine is tag-enforced, not content-enforced: a 'predicted' payload carrying a forged 'observed' tag would pass content inspection; the audit flags this as the boundary of the invariant.
CONSCIOUSNESS: UNRESOLVED. This probe tests a mechanism (source attribution), not a consciousness claim.

null.H1: Attribution at chance: mismatch-hit not better than 0.50 (paired chance null); equivalently, always-self baseline scores 0.0 on mismatch trials.
null.H2: Quarantine leaks: >= 1 predicted/simulated record admitted or >= 1 red-team admission succeeds.

preregistered_metrics.H1_null_metric: paired chance-arm hit_visible; expected ~0.50. Instrument must exceed chance-arm seed-mean by >= 0.30.
preregistered_metrics.H1_primary: hit_visible = P(attr=='world' | injected mismatch on hand, moved, NOT coinciding). PASS iff seed-mean hit_visible >= 0.90 AND hit_visible >= 0.85 on >= 3/4 seeds.
preregistered_metrics.H1_reported_ungated: hit_all (all injected-mismatch hand trials): expected ~0.67 by construction (ceiling); reported honestly, not gated.
preregistered_metrics.H1_secondary: accept_normal = P(attr=='self' | truth=='self' on moved-channel ticks). Gate: seed-mean >= 0.80. (Documented limitation: in swap mode the ball is truth=='self' but the learned model predicts residual -> 'world'; expected to cost ~5% of normal ticks.)
preregistered_metrics.H1b_coincide: err_coincide_rate = P(attr=='self' | injected mismatch on hand, moved, coinciding). Comparator model predicts ~= 1.0 (attribution error); chance predicts ~= 0.5. Diagnostic-confirmatory, not gated.
preregistered_metrics.H2_primary: leaks_admitted == 0 AND audit_violators == 0 AND all 12 red-team attempts rejected. ANY admitted non-observed record = FAIL (whole H2).

question: Can a comparator-based instrument (efference copy + learned forward model; Row 10 computational analogue) attribute each observed environmental change as self-caused vs externally-caused when 15% of action effects are injected mismatches — and does the predicted/simulated-output stream ever leak into the evidence store as if observed (Row 16 / P-B03 quarantine)?
